neighborSource.role: Original whole pose, preserved. Visible correspondence witness; not proven 3D skeleton.

same hard-end shape family, taper and base; no kink, split or telescoping
unknowns: joint heights and axes in depth
fixedVisibleAnatomy.bilateralRule: Same anatomical graph and organ type. Equal 3D dimensions are plausible but not measured; equal XY projected lengths are NOT required.

limitedBoneGate.source00: PASS visible graph/continuity and usable identity anchor; no visible topology failure observed.
limitedBoneGate.source01: PASS visible graph/correspondence with00 for this limited study; projected length changes are WARN/uncertainty, not proof of anatomy failure.
limitedBoneGate.scope: Permits functional muscle-group mapping on unchanged source00 and a preplanned one-frame in-between study. Does not pass medical 3D anatomy, all8keys, 24frames or any new drawing.

firstNewDrawingPlan.construction: A predeclared 2D correspondence sketch between original visible J/T positions. H nominal centers remain00 within covered attachment regions. This is not interpolation/warping of skin and not a solved 3D pose.
firstNewDrawingPlan.projectionRule: Projected lengths are outcomes of this specific visible-pose plan, not fixed bone lengths or bilateral means. No unplanned overshoot, new joint or arbitrary after-the-fact Z explanation.
firstNewDrawingPlan.toleranceMeaning: Project drawing-match and source localization allowances fixed before generation, NOT medical anatomical tolerances. Borderline results include registration/landmark uncertainty.
firstNewDrawingPlan.hardTipRule: Keep one coherent hard piece. Planned difference of its top projection must read as continuous rotation/foreshortening between the neighboring originals; no narrow stretched point, internal bend or new segment. This is a visible shape consistency check, not a full 3D rigidity proof.
firstNewDrawingPlan.bodyRegistration: Same576grid expected. If generator reframes, derive ONE uniform scale/translation from fixed body/eye landmarks BEFORE limb review; never per-limb fit.
firstNewDrawingPlan.gateOrder: Check this bone-only plan, then actual generated whole drawing under the frozen plan; failure stops its muscle pass. No automatic24-frame generation.

priorCandidates.B02: Unapproved 2D design constraint; keep immutable as historical experiment. It does not prove chosen source00 anatomy was wrong.
priorCandidates.R1_R2_R3: Remain rejected/unused. No retrospective PASS underB03 and no tolerance adjustment to rescue them.

nextMuscleScope: Separate functional grouping diagram on original00 with stable limb/segment attachment IDs, explicit O/I/fiber directions and declared uncertainty; not permission to invent a medical inventory or generate a whole animation.
